children: U.S. home-sale prices declined in October, Redfin says. That ends a three-year streak of monthly year-over-year gains that held even as mortgage rates climbed and would-be buyers pulled back. The median home-sale price declined 0.4% to $388,634 in October. With the total number of homes for sale at its highest level since early 2020 and demand cooling, homebuyers' negotiating power keeps increasing--and that's finally showing up in sale prices. Home-sale prices fell nationwide, but they rose in more than half of the 50 most populous U.S. metro areas. U.S. pending home sales fell 3.6% largely because mortgage rates averaged 7.33%, a three-year high and up from 6.86% the month before. (chris.wack@wsj.com)
